title: Choose PreDent's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Neem Courtyard Morning. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Neem Courtyard Morning
options.lineage: the Maharashtrian wada courtyard at sunrise, where the day starts with a neem datun
options.thesis: Dental care as the calm first ritual of a Nanded morning: peace and ease made physical.
options.viewport: Full-bleed sunlit limewashed wall with moving neem-leaf shadow; Dr. Prajakta's portrait set in a teak window; huge headline 'Peace & ease, from the first visit'; brass WhatsApp pill and the 4.8 rating drawn large beside it.
options.risk: Must stay unmistakably a modern specialist clinic, never read as an ayurvedic or herbal practice.

raised.raise: Proof becomes graphic argument: the 4.8 rating and 119 reviews set as one oversized inked figure, not a stat strip.
One ruling discipline: every divider and frame drawn at a single hairline weight.
Services open from a compact list into full detail in one pull, never a wall of cards.
Real Google reviews kept as a visitor's guest book with names and dates.
Motion follows one law: leaf shadows drift with a single, slow breeze direction across the page.

options.label: Paithani Border
options.lineage: Yeola Paithani silk, the saree Maharashtrian families keep for their proudest days
options.thesis: The clinic dressed in the Paithani its patients wear to celebrations, in the logo's own plum and zari gold.
options.viewport: Deep plum field framed by a woven gold border band; doctor portrait inset like a pallu panel; large headline with the Devanagari wordmark; zari-gold WhatsApp button.
options.risk: Matches the logo so closely it is the most expected choice; reads like a wedding card if the motifs multiply.

options.label: Station Status Board
options.lineage: the split-flap departure board at Nanded railway station
options.thesis: The clinic as a live board: OPEN NOW, closing time and services clacking into place.
options.viewport: A full-width flap board reading PREDENT · OPEN NOW · CLOSES 20:00, services as rows, and a WhatsApp row that books.
options.case: Railway boards are familiar to every Nanded family and 'open now' is genuinely useful; it loses on calm, which the peace-and-ease promise needs.
options.risk: Feels transactional and loud for anxious patients.

options.label: Du Bois Data Portraits
options.thesis: Clinic facts as bold hand-inked charts.
options.viewport: The 119 reviews as a crimson spiral.
options.case: Families do not recognise the form, and charts make a clinic feel like a report.
options.kept: Proof drawn as one bold graphic figure.

options.label: Centre-Rail Edition
options.thesis: The site as an annotated edition.
options.viewport: Two narrow columns round a vermilion key rail.
options.case: Too bookish for a phone-first family audience.

options.label: Miura-Fold Sheet
options.viewport: A gold packet that opens into the service grid.
options.case: Clever but abstract; nothing about it says dentist or Nanded.
options.kept: One pull reveals the whole service set.

options.label: Minihompy Room
options.thesis: The clinic as a little room you visit.
options.viewport: An isometric clinic room with a guest ledger.
options.case: Too playful for a specialist doctor; undercuts trust.
options.kept: Reviews as a visitor guest book.

options.label: Gravity-Rain Garden
options.case: Beautiful but unrelated to teeth or the clinic.
options.kept: Motion governed by one consistent law.

canonCard.label: Premium dental standard
canonCard.thesis: What premium dental sites on Dribbble ship, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Oversized editorial headline, one cinematic patient photo, a glass booking card and a review strip.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other clinic by design.
